primary_outcomes.measure: Tumor Necrosis Factor alpha expression in adipose tissue
primary_outcomes.time_frame: Change from baseline to the 3 month visit

brief_summary: Chronic, low-grade adipose tissue inflammation is a major risk factor for type 2 diabetes mellitus. The cause of adipose tissue inflammation has remained largely unclear. We hypothesize that vitamin D deficiency predisposes individuals to the development of adipose tissue inflammation, and that treatment of vitamin D deficient subjects with high dose vitamin D will reduce adipose tissue inflammation.
